meta.name: Pati Patni Aur Panga – Jodiyon Ka Reality Check
meta.description: Chhoti Nok-Jhok, Bade Pange! Beloved celebrity couples take on unconventional challenges that put their bond to the test whilst sparking a laughter ride.

videos.title: The Grand Premiere Begins
videos.overview: Chhoti Nok-Jhok, Bade Pange! Beloved celebrity couples take on unconventional challenges that put their bond to the test whilst sparking a laughter ride.

videos.title: Ghar Ki Kahaani, Help Ki Zubaani!
videos.overview: Jodiyon ke pehle pyaar unke house helps laaye hain full on masti! Ghar ke asli heroes ke saath hoga reality check, aur khulenge ghar ke spicy secrets!

videos.title: Rasmein Traditions With a Twist
videos.overview: Pati and Patnis relive their Shaadi days from Varmalas to Mehendi, every ritual gets tested, and PANGA takes the lead.

videos.title: Inked with Love
videos.overview: From changing diapers to getting inked, Pati and Patnis face wild "firsts". New experiences, new fears but every moment leaves a lasting mark.

videos.title: Pregnant Pati, Ghulam Patni
videos.overview: Tables turn! Patis face pregnancy pains. Patni's act as obedient Ghulams. Hilarious chaos, role reversal and full-on panga!

videos.title: Do Jism Ek Jaan
videos.overview: Couples unite mind & body to win the Ladoo! Expect epic coordination fails, missteps & non-stop couple comedy!

videos.title: Filmy Night
videos.overview: Costumes, chaos, and chemistry! From team rivalries to Insaaf Ka Tarazu to losing their way in the Dark Room—three twists of pure filmy madness!

videos.title: Kabhi Keechad Kabhi Kamai
videos.overview: Patnis and Patis faced ultimate pangas, Golgappe stalls, shoe shop chaos, and a head-to-toe keechad battle. Taal-mel tested like never before!

videos.title: Saas-Bahu aur Panga
videos.overview: When Patnis' love clashes with Maa's love, poor Patis land in the crossfire. Get ready for drama, emotions and laughter- the ultimate Ghar Ka tug-of-war.

videos.title: Romance with Twist- Fall in love
videos.overview: Patis and Patnis fall in love, only to land in the deep blues. Patnis take new Vachans and romance gets hilarious with the season's biggest twist because here every love story is Panga-style!

videos.title: Sehenshakti Ki Pariksha
videos.overview: Patis & Patnis faced the ultimate ‘Sehenshakti’ test! From ice buckets to dizzy chairs, patience cracked and entertainment blasted full power, Panga style!

videos.title: No Lies Zone
videos.overview: The lie detector test shook things up as Patis and Patnis faced hidden truths. Jodis did full pol khol, laughter erupted, and secrets were revealed in true Panga style.

videos.title: Biwi Number 1 Ka Panga
videos.overview: Sunita Ahuja enters with a hammer, ready to smash laddoos and spill secrets! She’s all set to bring laughter, drama, and excitement today!

videos.title: Shock Lagaa Kyaa
videos.overview: Seven couples compete for extra laddoos! From guessing lipstick marks to enduring shocks, they battle with enthusiasm and fun to claim the sweetest victory!

videos.title: Jodiyon Ki Takkar
videos.overview: Couples clash head-on to snatch their opponents’ Shaadi ka Ladoo. The fight grows tougher with every move. Who will survive the panga and win it all?

videos.title: Daav Laga
videos.overview: Jodis risk their most personal belongings, close to their hearts. Winners save it all; losers must face Mr Chaknachoor. Can love and strategy save their prized treasures?

videos.title: Navratri with Neha Kakkar
videos.overview: As Navratri beats take over, Neha’s musical Pangas set the stage ablaze! Patis groove with swagger on 'Garmi', and the Jodis lost in rhythm and rivalry go full Chappad-Faadd mode.

videos.title: Navratri Blessings with Radhe Maa
videos.overview: Radhe Maa arrives to heal the Jodis’ Pangas! Amidst a colour blast and unfolding secrets, Avika & Milind reveal their wedding card, seeking her divine blessings.

videos.title: Avika-Milind Ka Mahasangeet
videos.overview: Avika and Milind’s Mahasangeet is a celebration of music and Masti. With magical performances, it is an unforgettable night of laughter, love, and Hungama!

videos.title: Ladkiwale vs Ladkewale
videos.overview: The Sangeet Dhamal reaches new heights with leg-pulling, and endless Pangas. As the battle continues between Dulhan and Dulha’s teams, who will take the crown?

videos.title: Avika-Milind Ka Shubh Vivah!
videos.overview: On Avika and Milind’s wedding day, laughter and chaos ensue as the Mangalsutra goes missing, Hina and Isha plan Joota Churai, and Krushna and Samarth add fun to the festivities.

videos.title: The Wedding Festivities Continues!
videos.overview: At Avika’s grand Griha Pravesh, Farah and Dilip host a cooking challenge, husbands guess their wives by feet, and Rakhi adds her signature drama, sparking weekend chaos.

videos.title: Diwali Crackers with Mallika!
videos.overview: Mallika’s happy Diwali is full of crackers! Husbands dance on Maiyya Maiyya, Pawan adds Haryanvi fun, and Rubina’s emotional dare leaves everyone teary eyed!

videos.title: Ekta’s Diwali Dhamaka!
videos.overview: Ekta Kapoor's Diwali Dhamaka brings fun games and festive laughter! Astrologer Harsh’s quirky predictions leave the couples blushing and surprised!

videos.title: Masti Overloaded with Team Masti
videos.overview: When the Masti team meets our Jodis, the result is pure entertainment! Expect sizzling chemistry, shocking truths and a perfect dose of Panga, all stirred together.

videos.title: Panga with Shehnaaz
videos.overview: Shehnaaz’s quest for the perfect Pati turns into a laughter riot for our Jodis! Stay tuned as the show transforms into a full-on Panga paradise!

videos.title: India Ki Demand aur Jodiyon Ka Reality Check
videos.overview: India’s demand took center stage as couples faced the ultimate reality check! Sudesh and Mamta’s first date melted hearts, while Rocky, Pawan and Milind survived creepy-crawlies.

videos.title: Dare, Drama and The Great Laddoo Rescue
videos.overview: The couples took wild dares to save their laddoos! Gurmeet got his ear pierced, Rocky lost half his moustache, Geeta–Pawan gave theirs away, and the hubbies faced a Bump Pe Bomb!

videos.title: Laughter Chef Meets Pati Patni Aur Panga!
videos.overview: It’s a laugh riot as Team Laughter Chef collides with Pati Patni Aur Panga, filled with spicy twists, hilarious challenges, and endless laughter. Just keep the baby asleep!

videos.title: From Panga to Poison… Naagin Takes Over
videos.overview: Danger slithers into the House of Dhamaal as the Naagin enters. With Pati Patni Aur Panga couples already in chaos, being her friend is smart because being prey might just sting.

videos.title: Tables Can Turn! Dhamaal Finale
videos.overview: A high-stakes turning point night as the Jodis push for the finale, with the Laughter Chefs adding full-on Dhamaal.

videos.title: Who'll be the Sarvaguna Sampanna Jodi?
videos.overview: The Dhamaal finale reaches its peak as the top four Jodis battle fiercely for the ultimate title.

videos.title: Grand Premiere: Let the Panga Begin!
videos.overview: Sonali Bendre and Munawar Faruqui bring a banger season! It kicks off with Manoj Tiwari and Rahul Vaidya’s musical intro, and as the Jodis step in, the Panga is officially on.

videos.title: Navratri Special Festival With A Panga
videos.overview: Navratri celebrations get a ‘Dhamaal’ twist as the Jodis take on fun-filled festive challenges! Every reality check brings a fresh dose of festive fun, chaos, and Panga.

videos.title: Jodiyon Ka Pehla Impression
videos.overview: The Jodis revisit first impressions, assign quirky hashtags, and tackle GK questions! With husbands losing clothes, will wives pass the reality check, or will a new Panga unfold?

videos.title: Pati-Patni Ki Shikayatein!
videos.overview: The husbands team up with Sonali to burn their wives' complaints! As the couples try to identify the issues, will the 'Shikayatein' wash away, or will the Panga get messier?

videos.title: Ghar-Ghar Ki Baatein
videos.overview: From a peek into the Jodi’s homes to a debate over a stand-fan, anything can happen! Will the Jodis pass the reality check, or will the wives’ answers land the husbands in a Panga?

videos.title: Party Toh Banti Hai!
videos.overview: Music, surprises, and secrets waiting to be uncovered! With unexpected guests and a delicious twist, will the Jodis have a blast, or will their secrets turn the party into a Panga?

videos.title: Pati, Patni Aur Saas Ka Mahasangram!
videos.overview: With the Saas in the house, expect fiery confrontations, spicy gossip and hilarious nok-jhok. Will the Pati support his Patni or choose his mother’s side?

videos.title: The Ultimate Couple Test
videos.overview: Think you know your better half? Think again! From surprising sync-ups to unexpected twists, this Couple Connection delivers a roller-coaster of romance, drama and chaos.

videos.title: Pyaar Wali Diwali
videos.overview: A festive Diwali special episode featuring wildcard entries and celebratory tasks where the celebrity couples take on compatibility tests and festive games. The jodis balance romance with humor while navigating surprise challenges to claim the week's bragging rights.

videos.title: Diwali Party with Avinash and Eisha!
videos.overview: Festive celebrations continue with Avinash-Eisha's surprise entry. The Jodis tease the duo with endless leg-pulling and fun games, but will Avinash finally confess his feelings?

videos.title: Team Munawar vs Team Sonali
videos.overview: From hookstep face-offs and tricky quizzes to freezing ice tubs and unexpected twists, the Jodis go all out in an ultimate team battle! Acing extreme Panges, which team will win?

videos.title: Jodiyon Ka Connection
videos.overview: How well do the Jodis know each other? Their bond is put to an ultimate test as they take on quirky challenges and make some tough choices, bringing out surprises and revelations!

videos.title: Patis vs Patnis: Who Will Win?
videos.overview: Husbands and wives clash in a high-stakes battle for laddoos! With tougher challenges and egos on the line, who will have the last laugh?
